info.title: PawStay Booking Service
info.description: Node.js/Express/CommonJS/Mongoose. USER and STAFF are resolved through existing Auth /api/auth/me on every business request. UTC timestamps; VND integers. Internal caller identity comes only from a directional credential.

post.summary: Process an already verified Payment event
post.description: Only PAYMENT_TO_BOOKING_TOKEN credential is allowed. Valid business rejection is 200 with accepted=false and a terminal outcome; retry only transient transport/503 errors using the same event_id. Identical event replay is stable; conflicting payload is 409. No VNPAY signature/IPN processing here.

post.description: Only CARE_TO_BOOKING_TOKEN credential is allowed. Care must verify current STAFF before asserting actor_id. Successful and state-conflict results are persisted by request_id; a changed payload is 409. Check-in respects actual readiness, preparation/cleaning intervals and configured time window; checkout preserves/extends the resource buffer and rejects future conflicts atomically.

BookingInput.description: CARE requires start_at; BOARDING requires check_in_date and check_out_date. The two modes are mutually exclusive. Any price, duration, end_at, owner or status supplied by the client is rejected.
